A_semantic_classification.name: semantic_classification
A_semantic_classification.describes: Relation between a proposition and the supplied evidence.

definitions.SUPPORTED: Directly attested by supplied evidence, or a faithful paraphrase.
definitions.QUESTIONABLE: Supplied evidence is not sufficient to conclude with confidence.
definitions.UNSUPPORTED: Adds substantial unsupported content, or contradicts the evidence.
definitions.NON_SUBSTANTIVE: Purely editorial element with no new assertion. Must never hide a claim.

B_operational_decision.name: operational_decision
B_operational_decision.describes: What the system must do after validation.

definitions.PASS: Contract valid, coverage complete, all substantive units SUPPORTED.
definitions.REVIEW: Contract valid, one or more QUESTIONABLE units, no UNSUPPORTED, no technical block. Does not accept the production cache.
definitions.BLOCK: Invalid contract, coverage, evidence, UNSUPPORTED, or critical anomaly.

C_technical_conformance.name: technical_conformance
C_technical_conformance.describes: Whether the response respects the contract.

definitions.INVALID: Missing, unknown, mistyped, or incoherent contract content.

historical_confusion.paragraph_v: 2.0.1 schema required a semantic classification, but the instructions did not say so. Terra emitted PASS.
historical_confusion.sc_keys: 2.0.1 schema required lowercase count keys. Instructions said counts of k values, which are uppercase.

consolidated_rule: The model emits only semantic classifications and required justifications. Python computes PASS/BLOCK/REVIEW. The validator reports VALID/INVALID. No silent conversion between these spaces.
